contract: A fixed domain-adapter registry exposes only canonical non-secret records through platform.21 signed peer transport. workspace.records covers projects/tasks with canonical tombstones; knowledge.records covers authoritative KnowledgeStore items without embeddings or derived indexes; creative.catalog covers authoritative current JSON records for ingredients, moodboards, universes, authors, works, stories and series. Strict batches, per-peer cursors, common-ancestor hashes and the existing ConflictQueue preserve replay and conflict semantics. SQLite adapters fast-forward one-sided changes, propagate deletion only from an agreed ancestor, hold both-sided edits, and restore explicitly selected remote fields while preserving every unselected current local field. identity.goals maps human goal, planned-session, hierarchy-plan and check-in current rows under its own explicit directional scope. identity.profile maps the human progress profile, public twin configuration and non-private twin documents under a separate explicit directional scope; private twin documents remain local and a colliding remote public ID is refused rather than overwriting one. Request ledgers, immutable revisions, evaluation history, recipes, lifecycle, continuity journals and encrypted bundles do not replicate. communications.contacts maps canonical people and their source-identified touchpoints under a separate explicit directional scope. Complete-batch validation requires every touchpoint person_id to reference a transmitted person and refuses ambiguous duplicate contact identities before mutation. Social accounts, credential references, message bodies, calendar sources/events, import receipts and communication histories remain local. music.library maps authoritative current artist, track, album, repertoire-song, latest playlist-snapshot and deck metadata under an independent directional scope. Catalog, album and track identities are cross-validated, every artifact reference pins an exact slug/version, and deck export receipts are stripped. Artifact bytes, provider configuration and credentials, listening events/import receipts, practice-attempt ledgers, older playlist snapshots, deck history/renders/exports and catalog generation jobs remain local. wellbeing.health is an explicit opt-in scope for current body/pressure measurements, laboratory observations and imported device metrics. wellbeing.routines is a separate explicit opt-in scope for current substance entries/presets and intervention plans/observations. Both reuse canonical wellbeing.sqlite3 rows, common-ancestor tombstones and selected-field conflict restore. Artifact references retain exact slug/version metadata while bytes stay local; request/import/source ledgers, revision history, provider/access configuration, native helper/shared-file state, credentials and secrets never enter either scope. wellbeing.genome is a third, independently opt-in scope for canonical current genome source descriptors and source-linked variants. Source identity, declared assembly/sample, exact artifact slug/version/hash metadata, genotype provenance and current authored annotations replicate; raw source bytes, import/request ledgers and annotation revision history remain local. Complete-batch validation requires each variant to reference a transmitted source and each source variant_count to match its transmitted current variants. wellbeing.practice is an independently opt-in scope for terminal cognitive-session observations and current memory-practice schedules. Cognitive rows exclude active challenges and every hidden expected answer; scores remain locally derived by the owner store. Memory rows carry exact pinned content metadata but not card-content artifact bytes. Request receipts and prior session/card revisions remain local. wellbeing.life_calendar is a separate explicit opt-in scope for the current user-declared life-calendar configuration and current non-deleted events. The config projection strips its machine-local trigger_id before hashing or transport. Reminder delivery claims, inbox items, trigger definitions, request receipts and prior config/event revisions remain local. media.assets maps the actual current image/video MediaLibrary projection under the existing independent directional category: stable slug, user-facing name/tags/collection, kind/MIME/version, source, readonly state, update token and bounded origin provenance. It writes canonical NativeArtifactProvider metadata while leaving binary bodies and immutable lifecycle history outside this increment. creative.direction maps canonical current DirectionStore projects through its qualified standalone adapter and the central signed transport. It preserves exact source and output pins while leaving work bodies, artifact bytes and request ledgers with their owning stores; its independently default-denied scope uses the shared cursor, replay and conflict surface. identity.stories maps the current parent-linked life-story graph without request or revision ledgers. knowledge.collections maps current collections and explicit item memberships as one ordered complete batch and applies both entry sets atomically against existing canonical knowledge items. experience.stories maps current authored story graphs without player sessions or request authority. creative.commissions maps current commission definitions and exact source pins while creating receiver records disabled, planning-only and without triggers, dispatch, run or feedback authority.
acceptance: Two isolated homes exchange actual canonical project records through signed guarded HTTP, persist cursor/ancestor state across service restart, update records and propagate hard-delete tombstones without duplicates.
Independent edits from a common accepted batch hold the receiving local record and persist exact local/remote versions once in the existing conflict queue.

Identical batch replay returns the original receipt; changed same-sequence content, cursor gaps, wrong sender, mixed schema versions, incomplete/unknown entry coverage and disabled directional policy are refused.
Export is fixed to declared non-secret, non-derived inventory entries and never contains peer private keys, proof nonces, peer-policy databases, replication state or arbitrary requested paths.

Authenticated HTTP and native status expose coverage, cursors and conflict metadata without domain rows or secrets; console performs a real signed canonical-domain push and shows the persisted cursor.
Two isolated homes perform create, edit, delete and service-restart cycles for knowledge.records and creative.catalog canonical records with signed scope policy and idempotent replay.
Knowledge and creative both-sided edits retain exact versions in the existing queue; selected peer fields can be restored without overwriting unselected newer local fields.
Disabled knowledge.records and creative.catalog send policies refuse export before canonical data is read.

Two isolated homes exchange canonical human goals, planned sessions, goal plans and check-ins under identity.goals; independently edited goals hold local and restore selected fields, and an agreed deletion propagates after restart.

identity.profile exchanges the progress profile, public twin configuration and non-private identity documents; private identity text is absent from wire payloads and survives conflict restoration, while public document edits and deletion use the same ancestor semantics.
identity.goals and identity.profile are independent explicit peer-policy scopes and disabled send policy refuses each before reading canonical records.

Two isolated homes exchange canonical contacts and source-identified touchpoints with exact person references; independently edited people hold local and restore selected fields, and agreed person/touchpoint deletion converges after restart.

communications.contacts refuses incomplete touchpoint references before mutating the receiver, excludes social credential references and non-contact communication tables, and disabled policy refuses export before reading canonical rows.

Two isolated homes exchange current canonical artists, tracks, albums, songs, latest playlists and decks with exact cross-record and pinned artifact references; metadata edits conflict and restore selected fields while agreed deletion tombstones converge for every entry type.

music.library refuses missing album/track references before receiver mutation, excludes provider credentials and private tokens, leaves referenced binary artifacts absent, and denies export when the directional scope is disabled.
New peers receive no wellbeing policy by default; wellbeing.health and wellbeing.routines each require explicit directional opt-in and disabled policy refuses export before canonical rows are read.

Two isolated homes exchange actual current wellbeing store snapshots, preserve laboratory artifact pins without transporting bytes, validate intervention observation-to-plan references before mutation, restore selected measurement fields without replacing other local corrections, and converge canonical tombstones.
Wellbeing replication excludes request/import/source ledgers, revision history, access grants, native helper state, credentials, secrets and raw source artifacts from wire payloads.

Two isolated homes exchange actual GenomeStore source descriptors and current variants under wellbeing.genome, retain exact source references while leaving raw genome bytes absent, hold both-home annotation edits and restore only selected annotation fields.

wellbeing.genome is default-denied and independent of other wellbeing scopes; malformed source references and counts are refused before mutation, agreed source/variant deletion converges, recursive private-ledger material is absent, and disabled send policy denies export.

Two isolated homes exchange terminal CognitiveStore observations and current MemoryPracticeStore schedules under wellbeing.practice; no active challenge or hidden expected answer appears on the wire, and pinned card content bytes remain absent.

Both-home memory schedule/archive edits hold a conflict and selected archive restoration preserves the local practice schedule; agreed terminal-session/card deletion converges, malformed active-session input is refused before mutation, private request-ledger values are excluded, and disabled policy denies export.

Two isolated homes exchange actual LifeCalendarStore current configuration and events under wellbeing.life_calendar, reproduce the projection without creating remote automation state, and never transport trigger IDs, reminder claims, inbox item IDs or request-ledger secrets.

Both-home event edits hold a conflict and selected title restoration preserves local notes; an actual event deletion converges as a tombstone, malformed automation-bearing config is refused before mutation, default/disabled policy denies export, and the scope remains independent of every other wellbeing permission.

Two isolated homes exchange actual current image/video MediaLibrary metadata under media.assets while binary bodies, raw URLs, source paths, unrelated text artifacts and lifecycle event history remain absent from the wire.

Both-home media metadata edits hold a conflict and selected name restoration preserves local tags and local bytes; an actual artifact deletion converges as a tombstone, malformed binary-bearing metadata is refused before mutation, and default/disabled policy denies export.

The central signed creative.direction route proves recipient-bound scope policy and applies creative.direction_projects through DirectionStore without materializing source works, artifact bytes or request ledgers; peers without the explicit category are denied before owner-store reads.

identity.stories and experience.stories use independent default-denied policies, complete graph validation, shared cursor/conflict semantics and selected-field restore without transporting request ledgers, revision history or player state.

knowledge.collections applies ordered collection and membership entries through one atomic adapter operation, refuses missing transmitted collections or missing local canonical items before mutation, and restores only selected collection or membership fields.

creative.commissions replicates current definition rows and pinned source references while receiver execution authority remains disabled; dispatch, cadence, triggers, runs, feedback, credentials and artifact bytes remain local.
limitations: Current-record coverage now includes knowledge items and collections, identity goals/profile/life stories, authored experience story graphs, creative catalog/direction/commission definitions, contacts, music metadata and video projects, media metadata, and the declared wellbeing families. Message and calendar content remain outside the current communications scope. Immutable artifact and domain history requires a separate selective history protocol and is not counted as current-record coverage.

Knowledge uploaded source files and derived embeddings, chunks, FTS/index state, entity extraction and watched-source cursors remain excluded; creative revision/request/draft/artifact/suggestion/polish/continuity/voice stores remain excluded.

Identity request ledgers, story/revision history, fidelity runs, recipes, lifecycle/continuity journals and encrypted portability bundles remain local; private twin documents are never exported even when identity.profile is permitted.

Communications residual mapping: current people and touchpoints are covered; message mirrors and bodies, calendar sources/events, social accounts and credential references, import receipts/raw sources, relationship evidence/coverage, platform assignments, drafts/outboxes and all communication history remain unsupported by this scope.
Music artifact references identify exact immutable versions, but referenced audio, images, documents and generated outputs are not transported or counted as replicated records by music.library.

Health data sharing is off until each peer receives an explicit wellbeing.health, wellbeing.routines, wellbeing.genome, wellbeing.practice or wellbeing.life_calendar send/receive policy; enabling one scope does not authorize the other.

Genome replication transports sensitive current genotype and annotation rows only after exact wellbeing.genome peer opt-in; raw TSV/VCF bytes, import receipts, requests and prior annotation revisions remain local.

Practice replication includes terminal cognitive observations and current memory schedules only; active challenge state, expected answers, card-content bytes, request receipts and prior revisions stay local.

Life-calendar replication carries user-declared current configuration and events only; automation triggers, reminder claims, inbox deliveries, request receipts and prior revisions remain machine-local.

Media-library replication carries current image/video metadata and bounded origin provenance only; raw bodies, generated outputs, raw URLs, source paths and immutable lifecycle history await separate artifact/history contracts.

Creative-direction replication carries current canonical projects and exact source/output pins only; source work bodies, treatment artifact bytes and direction request ledgers remain with their owner stores.
Local loopback proves two-home signed transport; no externally provisioned peer or public certificate is claimed.
integration_hooks: Render apps/console/src/features/capabilities/platform/Replication.tsx from the shared platform Page.
Add /api/capabilities/platform/replication/receive to the shared token middleware exact bypass list; the handler accepts only a valid platform.21 peer proof and permitted domain.
Enroll capabilities/platform/replication.sqlite3 as secret/security machine-local state excluded from every export and replica.
Add further domains only through an explicit DOMAINS adapter entry whose inventory entries are canonical, non-secret, non-derived and independently qualified.
